activities.name: Tanglewood Music Festival Young Artists Program

rationale.intuition: Curtis admit rate is among the lowest in higher ed at ~4-6% (~160 students enrolled total, tuition-free, instrument-quota driven). Selection is 100% audition-by-faculty-panel; SAT/GPA are not collected for decisions. Even a Menuhin-tier candidate with Tanglewood fellowship faces high variance — Curtis's instrument-slot system means an exceptional violinist might face zero openings in a given year. Industry consensus: top-tier pipeline candidates 5-15%, average pipeline applicants <2%. Engine triggers MUSIC_CONSERVATORY sentinel (probability=0, insufficientData).

sources.name: Curtis Institute Admissions FAQ 2024
sources.evidence: Total enrollment ~160; admits decided exclusively via live audition by performance faculty; the institute admits to instrument-specific openings (some years zero violin slots open in a studio)

sources.name: League of American Orchestras Conservatory Outcomes Report 2023
sources.evidence: Curtis, Juilliard pre-college, NEC top-tier candidates cluster 8-20% admit at Curtis; below pipeline-tier candidates effectively 0%
